story: The Keeper's hook and close for the compilation The Complete Story of Noah (Genesis 5-9, KJV), said to the camera in 2 segments (his own words, apart from scripture)

narration.text: What if God told you to build a boat with no rain?
He obeyed before the rain came. What is God asking of you?
